title: A Survey of Evaluation Metrics Used for NLG Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that demonstrates how automatic evaluation metrics inherently favor certain system types (e.g., BLEU favoring n-gram models over rule-based systems) or language styles (e.g., metrics trained on social media favoring informal text).
Summarizing studies that identify layout bias in news datasets and noise in web-scraped datasets, which affect the reliability and correlations of evaluation metrics.
